title: Canonical theme palette
description: One canonical semantic palette per colorscheme. Roles are hue-independent; a role value is either a 6-digit hex or a reference to another role (@role-name). ANSI 0-15 are explicit hex. The native section carries the irreducible per-theme choices (Neovim/Zed colorscheme names). The module (theme/theme.py) is the enforcing validator; this schema documents the contract for review.

name.description: Palette identifier; also the bundle directory name.

roles.description: Semantic, hue-independent roles. Value is a hex or an @role reference.

ansi.description: Terminal ANSI slots 0-15, in order. Explicit hex only.

ghostty.description: Ghostty UI colors beyond the ANSI palette. Values are hex or @role references.

native.description: Irreducible per-theme native selections for rich editors that own a larger token graph than the shared role table. A null Zed value explicitly records that upstream provides no verified Zed theme.

zed.description: Verified Zed theme name, or null when unavailable upstream.

opacity.description: Optional per-role opacity metadata (0.0-1.0) for surfaces that render translucent, e.g. the active window border.
